fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Study or Research Plan 1000 words at least, in Chinese or English You can download a template or sample from here . * 2. Study Experience Resume The start and end time of each education experience must be uninterrupted, and education level should start from senior high school. You can download a template or sample from here . * 3. Physical Examination Record for Foreigners The medical examinations must cover all the items listed and should be conducted after October, 2025. You can download a template or sample from here . 4. Applicants of School of Architecture are requested to submit E-work Collection and Video Presentation * 5. Acceptance Letter from TJU Supervisor Remember to upload it to the application system if you get the Acceptance Letter. You can download a template or sample from here . 6. Contacts of professors You can download a template or sample from here . * 7. Certificate of HSK * 8. Photocopy of passport (Ordinary passport expires after September 2026). * 9. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 10. Scan of notarized copy of the high school academic transcripts or scan of international standardization test results Applicants who will not graduate before the application deadline must provide their current academic transcript. In this case, the completed academic transcripts must be submitted before registration. * 11. Scanned Copy of Highest Diploma Scan copy of Pre-graduation Certificate is required if the applicant has not gained degree certificate before the application deadline. Once admitted, students are required to present their original Bachelor Degree Certificate with the Degree Authentication Document upon registration for enrollment qualification review. Students who fail the enrollment qualification review will be disqualified from enrollment. * 12. Two Recommendation Letters in English or Chinese from two professors or associate professors. You can download a template or sample from here . * 13. Applicants must submit scan of Certificate of Non-Criminal Records It should be valid within six months prior to the application date. (Fresh graduates are required to submit a certificate that shows the applicant's good record of conduct and performance in their university). 14. Published papers * 15. Digital Signature Please sign your name on a white paper, and send us a scan copy of it; We will only use it to help you digitally sign some related documents during the application process. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport. For applicants who used to be Chinese citizens but later immigrated to other countries, the conditions set by the Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the Peoples Republic of China should be met. 2. Applicants must have a bachelors degree and be under the age of 35. Applicants should be in good health and of good character, be well-behaved and be willing to abide by China's laws and regulations, as well as the university rules. 3. Language proficiency requirements For Chinese-instructed program applicants: Students are required to submit HSK-5 certificates with a minimum score of 180. Native Chinese speakers and applicants who complete their undergraduate study in Chinese are allowed to be exempted from providing HSK Certificates.
